cards.card_text: First up is giving to the needy, and Jesus says not to sound a trumpet before you like the hypocrites do.
cards.verse_text: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men.
cards.snippet: …to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by…

cards.card_text: Why do the hypocrites sound a trumpet when they give to the needy?
cards.verse_text: So when you give to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by men.
cards.snippet: …to the needy, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and on the streets, to be honored by…

cards.card_text: Next up is prayer, and Jesus says don't be like the hypocrites.
cards.verse_text: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites.
cards.snippet: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites.

cards.card_text: Where does Jesus say the hypocrites love to stand and pray?
cards.verse_text: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites.
cards.snippet: And when you pray, do not be like the hypocrites.

cards.card_text: Now Jesus gets to fasting, and the warning sounds familiar: don't be somber like the hypocrites.
cards.verse_text: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting.
cards.snippet: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting.

cards.card_text: Jesus says the hypocrites disfigure their faces to show ___ they are fasting.
cards.verse_text: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting.
cards.snippet: When you fast, do not be somber like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces to show men they are fasting.

cards.card_text: Jesus says, "You hypocrite!" What does He say to do first?
Then Jesus says to them, 'You hypocrites!' He says Isaiah, one of Israel's prophets, prophesied correctly about them.

cards.verse_text: But Jesus knew their evil intent and said, “You hypocrites, why are you testing Me?
cards.snippet: But Jesus knew their evil intent and said, “You hypocrites, why are you testing Me?

cards.card_text: Then He doesn't hold back: "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites!"
cards.verse_text: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites!
cards.snippet: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, you hypocrites!

cards.card_text: Jesus says the master will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
cards.verse_text: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
cards.snippet: …will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

cards.card_text: Jesus answers them, “Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites…” and then He quotes Isaiah, a prophet (Isaiah 29:13).
cards.verse_text: Jesus answered them, “Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.
cards.snippet: Jesus answered them, “Isaiah prophesied correctly about you hypocrites, as it is written: ‘These people honor Me with their lips, but…

cards.card_text: A hypocrite A fool A scoffer
Then Jesus calls them hypocrites, people who know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and sky.

cards.verse_text: “So come and be healed on those days and not on the Sabbath.” “You hypocrites!” the Lord replied.
cards.snippet: …and be healed on those days and not on the Sabbath.” “You hypocrites!” the Lord replied.
